channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact fellowship - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Columbia Institute for Ideas and Imagination: Paris Fellowship 2027-28
    https://ideasimagination.columbia.edu/apply/applying-for-a-fellowship/
    Columbia University Institute for Ideas and Imagination · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 75,000 stipend, plus housing at Reid Hall in Paris and office and research support, September 2027 to May 2028. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact fellowships - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Iméra: 'This Is Not Another Fellowship' – Postdoctoral Residency 2026-27 (Aix-Marseille)
    https://www.imera.fr/en/this-is-not-another-fellowship-application-2026-27/
    Iméra – Institute for Advanced Study at Aix Marseille Université · deadline Closed 03 Jul 2026 · Free accommodation in campus apartment; travel expenses covered; office in co-working space. No cash stipend specified. No application fee.
  • TBA21-Academy: Tentacular Fellowship 2026-2027 (Ocean Space, Venice)
    https://tba21.org/oceanspace-research-tentacular-fellowship
    TBA21-Academy, with NICHE Centre for Environmental Humanities and the UNESCO Chair on Water, Heritage and Sustainable Development at Ca' Foscari University · deadline Closed 05 Jul 2026 · Total fellowship support EUR 26,000. Phase 1 (incubation): EUR 3,000 grant for independent research and initiative development. Phase 2 (activation): EUR 8,000 grant plus a EUR 15,000 activation budget. No application fee.
  • Canon Foundation in Europe Research Fellowships 2026 (Europe–Japan Exchange)
    https://portal.canonfoundation.org/
    Canon Foundation in Europe · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000 per year (pro-rated for shorter stays). No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact fellowship - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Emergence Art+Science Fellowships: Open Call for New Commissions (Emergence Festival 2027)
    https://www.d-iep.org/artsciencefellowships
    Emergence at All Scales (EAAS), with The Science & Cocktails Foundation, Stichting Paradiso and NWA Route Kunst · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Production budget up to EUR 20,000 including VAT per project (covers artist fees, materials, equipment, space, travel, accommodation, installation and presentation). Total call budget EUR 80,000 (around four projects). No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact fellowship - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• AEIP: Art4Change Storytelling Fellowship 2026
    https://www.africaeuropeinnovation.net/news/call-for-applications-art4change-storytelling-fellowship-2026/
    Africa-Europe Innovation Partnership (AEIP), implemented by The African Youth Café (TYC), funded by the European Union · deadline Closed 29 May 2026 · EUR 3,000 stipend per fellow to cover content production costs (transport, data, basic fieldwork needs), plus structured digital-storytelling training, editorial mentorship and platform access for publishing work. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact fellowship - week of 11 May 2026
item.description:
• Camargo Foundation: Fellowship 2027-2028
    https://camargofoundation.org/en/camargo-fellowship-2026-2027
    Fondation Camargo · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · EUR 3,500 stipend (EUR 350 per week for 10 weeks), basic transportation to and from Cassis, a furnished apartment on campus, and a studio or appropriate workspace, plus a reference library, music and conference room and open-air theatre. Art materials, technical equipment and shipping of artworks are NOT provided. No application fee listed.
